---
title: "algorithm_steps"
format: html
---

Since WOA evaluates the whole population each iteration (30 whales × 100 iterations = 3,000 calls), the script groups evaluations into blocks of 30, takes the best per block to get the per-iteration best trajectory, then thins to every 10th iteration.


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Rastrigin Surface: Levenberg-Marquardt vs WOA
# Packages needed: minpack.lm, metaheuristicOpt, plotly
# install.packages(c("minpack.lm", "metaheuristicOpt", "plotly"))
#
# Rastrigin: f(x,y) = 20 + x^2 - 10*cos(2*pi*x)
#                        + y^2 - 10*cos(2*pi*y)
# Global minimum at (0, 0), f = 0
# Dense grid of local optima — LM will get trapped,
# WOA's population search gives it a better shot.
#
# LM note: Rastrigin is not a natural least-squares problem.
# We use a finite-difference Jacobian trick: represent f as
# a single residual r = sqrt(f + eps), so sum(r^2) ~ f.
# LM will still follow gradient descent steps but won't have
# the curvature information to jump over local optima.
# ============================================================

library(minpack.lm)
library(metaheuristicOpt)
library(plotly)

# ============================================================
# 1. OBJECTIVE FUNCTION
# ============================================================
rastrigin <- function(params) {
  x <- params[1]; y <- params[2]
  20 + x^2 - 10*cos(2*pi*x) + y^2 - 10*cos(2*pi*y)
}

# ============================================================
# 2. SURFACE GRID
# ============================================================
x_seq <- seq(-5, 5, length.out = 100)
y_seq <- seq(-5, 5, length.out = 100)
z_mat <- outer(x_seq, y_seq, function(x, y) {
  20 + x^2 - 10*cos(2*pi*x) + y^2 - 10*cos(2*pi*y)
})

# ============================================================
# 3. LEVENBERG-MARQUARDT
#    Single residual r = sqrt(f + eps); sum(r^2) = f.
#    LM uses finite differences on r to approximate gradient.
#    Starting point away from origin so it has to work.
# ============================================================
lm_path <- data.frame(x = numeric(), y = numeric(), z = numeric())

residual_fn <- function(params) {
  z_val <- rastrigin(params)
  lm_path <<- rbind(lm_path, data.frame(
    x = params[1], y = params[2], z = z_val
  ))
  sqrt(z_val + 1e-10)   # single residual — LM gets gradient info only
}

lm_start <- c(x = 3.5, y = 3.5)   # far corner, several local optima away

lm_result <- nls.lm(
  par     = lm_start,
  fn      = residual_fn,
  control = nls.lm.control(maxiter = 500, ftol = 1e-12, ptol = 1e-12)
)

cat("=== RASTRIGIN ===\n")
cat("LM converged to:", round(lm_result$par, 5),
    "| f =", round(rastrigin(lm_result$par), 5), "\n")
cat("LM path steps:", nrow(lm_path), "\n")

# Deduplicate consecutive identical positions (LM sometimes
# re-evaluates the same point for Jacobian estimation)
lm_path_dedup <- lm_path[c(TRUE, rowSums(
  abs(tail(lm_path, -1)[,1:2] - head(lm_path, -1)[,1:2])
) > 1e-8), ]

# ============================================================
# 4. WOA
# ============================================================
woa_evals   <- data.frame(x = numeric(), y = numeric(),
                           z = numeric(), eval = integer())
eval_counter <- 0L

woa_obj <- function(params) {
  z_val        <- rastrigin(params)
  eval_counter <<- eval_counter + 1L
  woa_evals   <<- rbind(woa_evals, data.frame(
    x = params[1], y = params[2], z = z_val, eval = eval_counter
  ))
  z_val
}

numVar   <- 2
rangeVar <- matrix(c(-5, 5, -5, 5), nrow = 2)

set.seed(42)
woa_result <- metaOpt(
  FUN       = woa_obj,
  optimType = "MIN",
  algorithm = "WOA",
  numVar    = numVar,
  rangeVar  = rangeVar,
  control   = list(numPopulation = 40, maxIter = 150)
)

cat("WOA converged to:", round(woa_result$result, 5),
    "| f =", round(rastrigin(woa_result$result), 5), "\n")
cat("WOA total evaluations:", nrow(woa_evals), "\n")

num_pop  <- 40
num_iter <- 150

woa_path <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(num_iter), function(i) {
  idx   <- ((i-1)*num_pop + 1) : min(i*num_pop, nrow(woa_evals))
  block <- woa_evals[idx, ]
  best  <- block[which.min(block$z), ]
  data.frame(x = best$x, y = best$y, z = best$z, iter = i)
}))

keep_idx      <- unique(c(1, seq(10, num_iter, by = 10), num_iter))
woa_path_thin <- woa_path[woa_path$iter %in% keep_idx, ]

# ============================================================
# 5. PLOT
# ============================================================
# Clamp z for colour scale so the local optima ripples are visible
z_plot <- pmin(z_mat, 60)

fig <- plot_ly() %>%

  add_surface(
    x          = x_seq,
    y          = y_seq,
    z          = t(z_plot),
    colorscale = "Viridis",
    opacity    = 0.72,
    showscale  = FALSE,
    name       = "Rastrigin surface"
  ) %>%

  add_trace(
    data   = lm_path_dedup,
    x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~z,
    type   = "scatter3d", mode = "lines+markers",
    line   = list(color = "red",  width = 5),
    marker = list(color = "red",  size  = 5, symbol = "circle"),
    name   = "Levenberg-Marquardt"
  ) %>%

  add_trace(
    x = lm_path_dedup$x[1], y = lm_path_dedup$y[1],
    z = lm_path_dedup$z[1],
    type = "scatter3d", mode = "markers",
    marker = list(color = "darkred", size = 9, symbol = "circle"),
    name = "LM start"
  ) %>%

  add_trace(
    data   = woa_path_thin,
    x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~z,
    type   = "scatter3d", mode = "lines+markers",
    line   = list(color = "cyan",  width = 5),
    marker = list(color = "cyan",  size  = 5, symbol = "circle"),
    name   = "WOA (every 10th iter)"
  ) %>%

  add_trace(
    x = woa_path_thin$x[1], y = woa_path_thin$y[1],
    z = woa_path_thin$z[1],
    type = "scatter3d", mode = "markers",
    marker = list(color = "blue", size = 9, symbol = "circle"),
    name = "WOA start (population best)"
  ) %>%

  add_trace(
    x = 0, y = 0, z = 0,
    type = "scatter3d", mode = "markers",
    marker = list(color = "yellow", size = 11, symbol = "diamond"),
    name = "Global minimum (0,0)"
  ) %>%

  layout(
    title = "Rastrigin: Levenberg-Marquardt vs WOA",
    scene = list(
      xaxis  = list(title = "x"),
      yaxis  = list(title = "y"),
      zaxis  = list(title = "f(x,y)"),
      camera = list(eye = list(x = 1.7, y = 1.7, z = 1.1))
    ),
    legend = list(x = 0.01, y = 0.99),
    annotations = list(list(
      text = paste0(
        "LM final: (", round(lm_result$par[1],3), ", ",
        round(lm_result$par[2],3), ")  f=",
        round(rastrigin(lm_result$par),3),
        "<br>WOA final: (", round(woa_result$result[1],3), ", ",
        round(woa_result$result[2],3), ")  f=",
        round(rastrigin(woa_result$result),3)
      ),
      xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
      x = 0.01, y = 0.06,
      showarrow = FALSE,
      font = list(size = 12, color = "white"),
      bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)"
    ))
  )

htmlwidgets::saveWidget(fig, "rastrigin_optim.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
cat("Saved to rastrigin_optim.html\n")

fig
```



```{r}
# ============================================================
# Rosenbrock Surface: Levenberg-Marquardt vs WOA
# Packages needed: minpack.lm, metaheuristicOpt, plotly
# install.packages(c("minpack.lm", "metaheuristicOpt", "plotly"))
#
# Rosenbrock: f(x,y) = (1 - x)^2 + 100*(y - x^2)^2
# Global minimum at (1, 1), f = 0
# Unimodal but has a narrow curved banana-shaped valley.
# LM excels here (natural least-squares structure).
# WOA struggles with the narrow valley — its position updates
# tend to overshoot or miss the valley floor.
#
# LM residuals (natural formulation):
#   r1 = 1 - x          => r1^2 = (1-x)^2
#   r2 = 10*(y - x^2)   => r2^2 = 100*(y-x^2)^2
# sum(r^2) = f(x,y) exactly. This is the ideal case for LM.
# ============================================================

library(minpack.lm)
library(metaheuristicOpt)
library(plotly)

# ============================================================
# 1. OBJECTIVE FUNCTION
# ============================================================
rosenbrock <- function(params) {
  x <- params[1]; y <- params[2]
  (1 - x)^2 + 100*(y - x^2)^2
}

# ============================================================
# 2. SURFACE GRID
# Clamp display to z <= 500 so the valley is visible
# ============================================================
x_seq <- seq(-2, 2,   length.out = 100)
y_seq <- seq(-0.5, 3, length.out = 100)
z_mat <- outer(x_seq, y_seq, function(x, y) {
  pmin((1 - x)^2 + 100*(y - x^2)^2, 500)
})

# ============================================================
# 3. LEVENBERG-MARQUARDT
#    Natural residual formulation — LM is perfectly suited here.
# ============================================================
lm_path <- data.frame(x = numeric(), y = numeric(), z = numeric())

residual_fn <- function(params) {
  x <- params[1]; y <- params[2]
  lm_path <<- rbind(lm_path, data.frame(
    x = x, y = y, z = rosenbrock(params)
  ))
  c(1 - x, 10*(y - x^2))   # natural residual vector
}

lm_start <- c(x = -1.5, y = 2.5)   # far corner of the banana

lm_result <- nls.lm(
  par     = lm_start,
  fn      = residual_fn,
  control = nls.lm.control(maxiter = 500, ftol = 1e-14, ptol = 1e-14)
)

cat("=== ROSENBROCK ===\n")
cat("LM converged to:", round(lm_result$par, 6),
    "| f =", round(rosenbrock(lm_result$par), 8), "\n")
cat("LM path steps:", nrow(lm_path), "\n")

# Deduplicate (Jacobian evaluations re-use same point)
lm_path_dedup <- lm_path[c(TRUE, rowSums(
  abs(tail(lm_path, -1)[,1:2] - head(lm_path, -1)[,1:2])
) > 1e-8), ]

# Clamp z for plotting so the path stays visible on the surface
lm_path_dedup$z <- pmin(lm_path_dedup$z, 500)

# ============================================================
# 4. WOA
# ============================================================
woa_evals    <- data.frame(x = numeric(), y = numeric(),
                            z = numeric(), eval = integer())
eval_counter <- 0L

woa_obj <- function(params) {
  z_val        <- rosenbrock(params)
  eval_counter <<- eval_counter + 1L
  woa_evals   <<- rbind(woa_evals, data.frame(
    x = params[1], y = params[2], z = z_val, eval = eval_counter
  ))
  z_val
}

numVar   <- 2
rangeVar <- matrix(c(-2, 2, -0.5, 3), nrow = 2)

set.seed(42)
woa_result <- metaOpt(
  FUN       = woa_obj,
  optimType = "MIN",
  algorithm = "WOA",
  numVar    = numVar,
  rangeVar  = rangeVar,
  control   = list(numPopulation = 40, maxIter = 200)
)

cat("WOA converged to:", round(woa_result$result, 6),
    "| f =", round(rosenbrock(woa_result$result), 8), "\n")
cat("WOA total evaluations:", nrow(woa_evals), "\n")

num_pop  <- 40
num_iter <- 200

woa_path <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(num_iter), function(i) {
  idx   <- ((i-1)*num_pop + 1) : min(i*num_pop, nrow(woa_evals))
  block <- woa_evals[idx, ]
  best  <- block[which.min(block$z), ]
  data.frame(x = best$x, y = best$y, z = best$z, iter = i)
}))

keep_idx      <- unique(c(1, seq(10, num_iter, by = 10), num_iter))
woa_path_thin <- woa_path[woa_path$iter %in% keep_idx, ]

# Clamp z for visibility
woa_path_thin$z <- pmin(woa_path_thin$z, 500)

# ============================================================
# 5. PLOT
# ============================================================
fig <- plot_ly() %>%

  add_surface(
    x          = x_seq,
    y          = y_seq,
    z          = t(z_mat),
    colorscale = "Hot",
    opacity    = 0.72,
    showscale  = FALSE,
    name       = "Rosenbrock surface"
  ) %>%

  add_trace(
    data   = lm_path_dedup,
    x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~z,
    type   = "scatter3d", mode = "lines+markers",
    line   = list(color = "red",  width = 5),
    marker = list(color = "red",  size  = 5, symbol = "circle"),
    name   = "Levenberg-Marquardt"
  ) %>%

  add_trace(
    x = lm_path_dedup$x[1], y = lm_path_dedup$y[1],
    z = lm_path_dedup$z[1],
    type = "scatter3d", mode = "markers",
    marker = list(color = "darkred", size = 9, symbol = "circle"),
    name = "LM start"
  ) %>%

  add_trace(
    data   = woa_path_thin,
    x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~z,
    type   = "scatter3d", mode = "lines+markers",
    line   = list(color = "cyan",  width = 5),
    marker = list(color = "cyan",  size  = 5, symbol = "circle"),
    name   = "WOA (every 10th iter)"
  ) %>%

  add_trace(
    x = woa_path_thin$x[1], y = woa_path_thin$y[1],
    z = woa_path_thin$z[1],
    type = "scatter3d", mode = "markers",
    marker = list(color = "blue", size = 9, symbol = "circle"),
    name = "WOA start (population best)"
  ) %>%

  add_trace(
    x = 1, y = 1, z = 0,
    type = "scatter3d", mode = "markers",
    marker = list(color = "yellow", size = 11, symbol = "diamond"),
    name = "Global minimum (1,1)"
  ) %>%

  layout(
    title = "Rosenbrock: Levenberg-Marquardt vs WOA",
    scene = list(
      xaxis  = list(title = "x"),
      yaxis  = list(title = "y"),
      zaxis  = list(title = "f(x,y) [clamped at 500]"),
      camera = list(eye = list(x = 1.8, y = -1.5, z = 1.2))
    ),
    legend = list(x = 0.01, y = 0.99),
    annotations = list(list(
      text = paste0(
        "LM final: (", round(lm_result$par[1],4), ", ",
        round(lm_result$par[2],4), ")  f=",
        round(rosenbrock(lm_result$par), 6),
        "<br>WOA final: (", round(woa_result$result[1],4), ", ",
        round(woa_result$result[2],4), ")  f=",
        round(rosenbrock(woa_result$result), 6)
      ),
      xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
      x = 0.01, y = 0.06,
      showarrow = FALSE,
      font = list(size = 12, color = "white"),
      bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)"
    ))
  )

htmlwidgets::saveWidget(fig, "rosenbrock_optim.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
cat("Saved to rosenbrock_optim.html\n")
fig
```
